verdict.rationale: Viam documents remote, real-time inspection of a deployed machine. You can stream camera feeds, read sensor data and visualize machine state from the browser through built-in NAT traversal, and `GetMachineStatus` via the machine API or CLI reports resource health and why a resource is unhealthy. However, no evidence shows remote access to machine logs, and there is no topic-style inspection. missing for 10: documented remote log viewing/streaming, explicit topic or message inspection, independent hands-on corroboration of remote debugging

support.subject: As a robotics engineer, I can inspect live topics, logs, and state on a deployed robot remotely to debug issues

citations.quote: Stream camera feeds, read sensor data, and visualize machine state in real-time from your browser.
List the resources (`ResourceNames`) and their state (`GetMachineStatus`). A resource that is still configuring or unhealthy will fail every call; the status says why.
The machine API allows you to connect to your machine from within a supported Viam SDK, retrieve status information, and send commands remotely.
Built-in NAT traversal means you connect to any machine through firewalls and routers.
